title: A Study of Baricitinib (LY3009104) for the Delay of Stage 3 Type 1 Diabetes in At-Risk Children and Adults (BARICADE-DELAY)
official: I4V-MC-JAJJ: A Phase 3, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study of Baricitinib to Delay Stage 3 Type 1 Diabetes in At-risk Participants Aged ≥1 to <36 Years
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate superiority of baricitinib versus placebo in delay of Stage 3 type 1 diabetes in persons at risk for type 1 diabetes.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have at least two diabetes-related autoantibodies in their history, AND have two diabetes-related autoantibodies at screening or prescreening
2. Be at risk for type 1 diabetes (have Stage 1b or Stage 2)
3. Weigh at least 8 kilograms (kg) (18 pounds) at screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have diabetes (Stage 3)
2. Have uncontrolled high blood pressure
3. Have had a heart attack, heart disease, stroke, or heart failure
4. Have a history or high risk of blood clots or certain types of cancer
5. Have a current or recent serious infection
